scope: Bounded checked JS counter modulo optimization, ordinary Dart code unchanged. Not general native or browser performance parity.

policy.flags: Default checked own-SDK production, DARTFORGE_JSPROD_COUNTER_MODULO=0 vs1; both retain all other settings. Official dart2js -O2 SDK3.6.2, checked.
policy.eligible: Fresh int counter+0, single+1 update, unescaped/unmodified binding, known positive decimal divisor<=1e9, certified canonical SDK helper.
policy.refusals: SDK units, actual foreign JS intrinsic identities, closures, declarations, assignments, nested loops, unknown AST/control forms, negative/zero/dynamic/oversized divisors.
policy.signed_zero: Nonnegative +0 counter with only+1 cannot produce negative dividend or wrap negative; at Number precision limit increment stalls.
policy.existing_divergence: Integer modulo zero separately recorded: VM UnsupportedError; official O2 and Forge (toggleoff/on) NaN.

gates.command: cargo test --locked -p dartforge-emit-js -p dartforge-emit-js-production --lib --test native_number_ranges --test typed_native_length --test typed_loop_ranges --test numeric_dynamic_operands --test positive_counter_modulo -j2 -- --include-ignored
gates.analyzer: Ordinary positive/zero fixtures: No issues found. Private JS intrinsic fixture intentionally is SDK-only, unavailable on VM.

prototype.note: Manual replacement measured separately; final gains are compiler toggle ablation, not prototype.

browser_scope: Final loaded script SHA verified; overview mounted2, no uncaught Runtime/console/log/HTTP diagnostics. Ten debugger-caught exceptions preserved and baseline-matched; no exception-free/all-features claim.
